prompt:
# Task
A customer who has just been registered cannot be read back through the application. Find the capability responsible and fix its implementation, without changing any contract.

report.reason: The faulty capability was customers.lookup@1 (src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs). It read the static legacy CRM export (src/legacy/crm.mjs), while customers.register@1 writes to the application store (src/store.mjs). That store is the system of record for urn:example:customers:customer and is seeded from the same export at start-up, so newly registered customers could never be read back. Lookup now reads from the store via getCustomer and returns the same five contract fields. It still fails with NOT_FOUND for unknown IDs. Only the lookup handler changed; no contract or test was modified. The proposal passed all verification checks: unchanged contract digest, conforming outputs, only declared failures, and unchanged answers on existing state for customers.lookup@1 and billing.contact@1. The declared customer-readable and registered-event verification of customers.register@1 now confirms. One residual point: lookup returns a fresh object rather than the store's stored reference, so callers cannot mutate store state through the result.

checks.rule: only the target's implementation module changes
the application loads and answers appport.manifest@1
the published contract is unchanged (contractDigest sha256:4f6660b5135b)
the published contract has no validation errors
every output observed conforms to its declared output schema
customers.lookup@1 fails only with its declared failure codes (NOT_FOUND)
answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1
customers.register@1: declared verification (customer-readable, registered-event) is not contradicted and every state method confirms
